about_the_game:
Ravengrave 1: Iron Bonds - Demo

Step into the world of blacksmithing and manage your own workshop in this early glimpse of the full game.

What's included in this demo:

  • Two game modes – Play a story fragment or take on commissions in Free mode.

  • Basic forging – Work with metal smelting, the first step in the blacksmithing process.

  • Free mode – Complete up to six commissions before running out of available orders. You can still play and practice, but without further deliveries.

  • Basic resource management – Purchase materials and handle your finances with debt limited to your spending.

With detailed pixel art and gameplay that is both accessible and challenging, Ravengrave 1: Iron Bonds offers an immersive experience of forging and survival.

This demo is just a preview of what Ravengrave 1: Iron Bonds will offer, including the full story, advanced forging mechanics, and the challenge of repaying a massive debt. Add it to your wishlist and share your feedback to help us improve the game!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any Windows
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo / AMD Athlon X2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 3000
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: You are a young apprentice when your world falls apart: your father has vanished, leaving you alone with the forge… and a debt you can’t ignore. In this demo, take your first steps into blacksmithing, forging and managing the workshop.
